note: Function-tool definitions for agent platforms. Each tool is run as: node agentoon-tool.mjs <tool name> '<JSON arguments>' and returns one JSON object on stdout ({ok:true,...} or {ok:false,error}). Free, local, no API keys.

tools.name: render_3d_video
tools.description: Render a code-generated 3D scene (villas, pool, trees, paths, sun and shadows, orbiting or fly-through camera) to an MP4. Use only when the user asks for something 3D. Render a small preview first, look at the contact sheet, fix the spec, then render the final. See spec-reference.md for the spec.

spec.description: Scene spec object, or a path to a spec JSON file.

out.description: Output .mp4 path. Use a new filename each time.

frames.description: Render only the first N frames (fast preview).

contact_sheet.description: Optional .png path for a contact sheet to review the result.

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Edit video files with FFmpeg: info, trim, resize (fill 9:16), speed, join with cross-fades, mix audio to about -15 LUFS, contact sheet. Use only when the user asks to edit, join or assemble video. Always write to a new output file.

input.description: Input video (info, trim, resize, speed, audio, sheet).
